title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. translated_title: 诊断与改进大语言模型中的概率推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被提议作为决策助手，它们必须在明确的决策成本下基于现有证据进行概率推理。我们提出了一个决策理论框架，将LLM的决策损失分解为两个组成部分：从提供的证据中形成准确的信念，以及将这些信念转化为能优化给定效用函数的行动。利用一个具有已知真值的合成基准，我们应用该分解来刻画前沿模型和开源模型的概率推理能力。我们进一步评估了针对信念、决策或两者的强化学习干预能否在三个领域中改进这些组成部分，改进能否在不同组成部分和引出格式之间迁移，以及决策性能能否在信念形成未获改进的情况下得到提升。我们发现，针对概率推理的单一组成部分会重新分配决策损失，改进……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个决策理论框架，将大语言模型的决策损失分解为信念形成与行动选择两个组成部分，并通过合成基准和强化学习干预系统诊断并改进大语言模型的概率推理能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLM decision loss into belief formation and action selection components, using a synthetic benchmark and RL interventions to systematically diagnose and improve probabilistic reasoning in LLMs.
